Statistics contract

Source: R/filtering.R
stats-contract.Rd

All group-statistics closures in this package share one signature so they are drop-in replaceable in process_pseudo_spec() and clean_pseudo_spectra():

Details


  function(dt) -> per-group summary data.table

dt holds one feature's rows from batch_get_feature_data() (one row per MS1 scan × following MS2 centroid), after process_pseudo_spec() has dropped rows without a fragment, applied the apex window, and added group (from the grouper) and group_mz (the consensus m/z, constant within a group).

The closure returns one row per group with at least


  group, fragment_mz, mz, int, ms1_int,
  correlation, p_value, fdr, count, n_samples

where fragment_mz is group_mz carried through. Extra columns are allowed (e.g. apex_shift_med, apex_shift_iqr). It should not threshold; that is the filter-contract closure's job. clean_pseudo_spectra() reads fragment_mz, group, int, n_samples, count, correlation, p_value and fdr from the filtered result.

Optionally attach the (group, sample, ms1_scan) aggregate as attribute "grouped_signal"; the diagnostic report plots it.
